headline: BLACK HOLE: every pixel is a real geodesic
lede: The studio's most physics-honest demo yet: a slow flight past a Schwarzschild hole where the starfield bends around the shadow, the accretion disk wraps over and under it, and the approaching side burns platinum-white by relativistic beaming.

notes.text: #903 shipped: blackhole.html — RK4 null-geodesic lensing verified against a stiff reference within ~1% at b=4/6/10, capture cone at b_crit=2.598 rs, Keplerian disk with Doppler beaming (I ~ delta^3) and gravitational redshift.

blackholecheck 31/31 with RK4-anchored bending gates, halo-lift and Doppler probes, and a headless-sync-pipeline detector for the speed budget. Proven red: kill the beaming factor and both Doppler gates fail.
Symplectic Euler pumps orbital energy — it faked captures at b=6. The impossible pair (bend vs rMin<b) found it; straight-line rs=0 tests proved the measurement, and RK4 fixed the physics.
One observed-temperature colour law (T_obs ~ delta·g·T) makes the bright side whiter AND passes the pixel gate; a hand-painted blue tint failed the same test.
